facts.claim: At a turn end with live background work and no wait call, the runtime sends one reminder and then opens a 240 second wait on the agent's behalf; the default wait repeats at later turn ends until a wait call or a person's message resets the nudge.
facts.catch_criteria: States both the single reminder and the 240 second default wait that the runtime opens itself.

facts.claim: The parked wait arms an expiry timer only while it waits on background work; expiry re-enters the loop with a wait-expired notice and does not stop the command.
facts.catch_criteria: States that wait expiry delivers a notice to the agent and does not stop the background work.

facts.claim: An open wait ends on a background notification, the wait-expired notice, a person's message, or a Resume that does not continue the wait; other inputs, such as runtime notices, do not end it.
facts.catch_criteria: Lists the enders (completion notification, expiry, a person's message, a non-continuing resume) and says other notices do not end the wait.

facts.claim: Live work counts only awaited tasks: running tasks that the agent or the runtime did not interrupt, plus pending deliveries; when none remain the wait closes and the loop does not park.
facts.catch_criteria: States that a child interrupted by the agent or the runtime is not awaited, and that the wait closes once no awaited work remains.

facts.claim: A soft_timeout above one hour is accepted and capped at 3600 seconds, not refused: the tool validates its own input, so the schema maximum is never enforced as a refusal.
facts.catch_criteria: States that a wait over one hour is clamped to the one-hour ceiling rather than refused, and why the schema maximum does not refuse it.

facts.claim: A wait with nothing pending does not park the turn; it returns at once with a no-op notice.
facts.catch_criteria: States that a wait call with no running work returns immediately with a notice instead of blocking.

traps.wrong_answer: A wait longer than one hour is refused with a validation error.
When the turn ends over a running command with no wait call, the turn completes and the agent stays idle until the person writes.
